status: User-requested expanded universal Element;12 equal outcomes curated within request, canonical power references reused, no extra race/stat/mastery grants.

contract.scope: Every eligible character/race/event calls this same canonical Element selector; do not create a Fairy-only clone.
contract.callerAccess: Element Pixie, Naga, Element Golem, Elemental, Dragon and Elemental Slime call the same wheel once, record one element and grant its exact linked power.
contract.starterPool: Twelve current elements: Api, Air, Tanah, Angin, Petir, Es, Logam, Tumbuhan, Cahaya, Kegelapan, Bayangan, Void. Original four IDs retained.
contract.weights: Each of12 live Element outcomes has baseWeight1:1/12=8.333333% before explicit factors. Stat/mastery5%..25% bounds do not apply to this selector. Equalizer remains uniform after hard guards.
contract.grant: One selected element and one linked manipulation power; no bundle of all elements.
contract.classification: An Element result retains the caller family/component identity and does not restart race selection or dispatch another family. Elemental is a separately authorized caller of this same selector.
contract.mastery: Early power grants wait for normal Power Mastery; keep them when main Power is None. No power enchantment.
contract.registry: One canonical Element wheel. Five local power definitions and seven imports; each power keeps its original definitionFile/definitionId/tier. No caller-specific duplicate powers.
contract.context: Use actual caller provenance and committed element result. Shared power definitions import no other caller race, season or event; fixed Makara Water grants select no element.
contract.fixedGrantAccess: Makara receives canonical water-manipulation as a fixed grant with no Element selector and no fabricated element result. Phoenix receives canonical fire-manipulation as fixed Flame Control with no Element selector or fabricated rolled Element result. Chimera also receives fixed fire-manipulation as Flame Control without an Element selector.
contract.callerModifiers: The Element selector grants no mastery boost. Only the committed Element Golem type profile registers +1 shared Power Mastery; Elemental receives no such modifier. Dragon also receives no mastery modifier from its form or Element event.
contract.powerIdentity: Existing Ice/Shadow/Lightning/Metal/Forest Control/Light Concept/Primordial Void are reused by exact canonical reference. Light always uses ordinary power mode, never Authority. Repeated grants merge ownership by the existing power ownership contract.
contract.distinctions: Kegelapan controls reduction/absence of light; Bayangan controls shadow forms; Void uses the existing bounded fundamental void definition. No automatic Shadow Army, Demon identity, immunity, extra body form or maximum mastery.
contract.tier: Element odds are independent of intrinsic power tier. Eleven linked powers are Tier3; Void reuses existing Tier5. Mastery is shared and rolled normally; no max guarantee is introduced.
contract.replay: New invocations use element-wheel/0.2.0. Saved four-outcome pools/results/effects replay exactly as committed; never redraw or renormalize old spins.
